summary: Texas list marks a tower at Winchester, Lee County, as gone; Wikipedia puts the community in Fayette County, so the county is unsettled.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Texas lookout list. No source read for this record describes what remains at the site now.

evidence.supports: Texas list: Winchester tower in Lee County, coordinates 30.06944, -96.96694, status Gone
Wikipedia: the Winchester community is in northwestern Fayette County
evidence.quote: Winchester is an unincorporated community in northwestern Fayette County

notes_for_editor: Index-only record for the tower, plus Wikipedia for the community. The index puts the tower in Lee County; Wikipedia puts the Winchester community in Fayette County and gives it at 30.00944, -97.01389, which differs from the tower's listed point. Left unresolved in the story. Two searches and several page reads found no build, staffing, fire or removal detail. The TFS history page (tfsweb.tamu.edu, id 19538) returned 403. Lead for later: Cavallerano, Fire in the Piney Woods (muse.jhu.edu/book/137054), which covers Texas lookout tower locations and design. Confidence low.
